items.headline: Nvidia market cap falls ~$700B as board weighs ousting CEO Jensen Huang amid espionage-linked affair scandal
items.why: Leadership crisis at the dominant AI chipmaker revives a Washington push to tighten China chip export controls, adding policy risk to AI capex chain.

items.headline: PBOC drops pledge of added stimulus, raises bank FX reserve requirement to 6% from Nov 15
items.why: Signals Beijing shifting from easing to delivery mode; shapes yuan, China liquidity and risk-asset outlook into year-end.

items.headline: Anthropic targets $1.3T IPO valuation; Google and Nvidia each commit $10B in $26B anchor order
items.why: First major AI-lab IPO sets the public-market bar for AI valuations and locks in hyperscaler capital ties.

items.headline: Anthropic sets Nasdaq IPO price range at $70–$78/share, targeting $1.4T valuation in up to $90.4B raise (IPO + private placement)
items.why: Would be the largest-ever public listing and first frontier AI lab IPO, setting the market benchmark for AI-lab valuations.

items.headline: Broadcom signs $42B custom-chip note agreement with Anthropic, expects to be its largest custom-silicon customer in 2027
items.why: Confirms Broadcom's AI ASIC backlog and diversification beyond Google/Meta, a key bull case for AVGO.

items.headline: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate hit $80B in October 2026, up from $65B in July (WSJ), ahead of ~$1.4T IPO pricing
items.why: Hypergrowth (80x YoY) supports premium IPO valuation but invites scrutiny on durability of consumption-based revenue vs OpenAI competition

items.headline: Tencent and Alibaba reportedly in talks to invest in DeepSeek at $20B+ valuation
items.why: Would be DeepSeek's first outside capital, tying China's two biggest tech platforms to its leading open-weight model.

items.headline: Anthropic signs $3.4B deal for 1.7GW of gas power generators to fuel AI data centers
items.why: Largest direct power-equipment purchase by an AI lab shows compute growth is now gated by electricity, not chips.

items.headline: OpenAI raises $11B in first tranche at $1.25T valuation, round may grow toward $20B
items.why: Largest private AI valuation to date, though below the $1.4-1.5T target sought, a signal on investor appetite ceiling.

items.headline: Google to invest $17B in Wyoming AI data center campus bought from Crusoe
items.why: Adds to hyperscaler capex arms race underpinning AI infrastructure demand

items.headline: PBOC shifts policy anchor to the overnight repo rate, pushing Chinese bank funding costs to record lows
items.why: De facto monetary easing signal for China, relevant to China AI-stock risk appetite and yuan-linked capex.

items.headline: Shield AI to buy radar maker Echodyne for $5.3B, raising $2.5B incl. $1B Series H at $28.8B valuation
items.why: Major AI-defense consolidation and a $1B+ markup showing AI-autonomy valuations still rising despite broader selloff

items.headline: Alibaba, ByteDance and Tencent order hundreds of thousands of Huawei Ascend 950 chips after DeepSeek V4 launch
items.why: China's AI champions committing at scale to domestic silicon reduces Nvidia's addressable China market.

items.headline: Tencent releases 'Hy4' model, claims top-tier status among China's open-weight AI systems, beating DeepSeek and Zhipu
items.why: Shows China's open-weight AI race intensifying, pressuring both domestic rivals and US model pricing power.

items.headline: Marvell agrees to combine with Lumentum in ~$115B deal, year's largest chip/optical-component merger
items.why: Consolidates AI data-center optical interconnect supply, a key bottleneck for scaling compute networks.
